data: Is the observed game score of the red line higher than that of the green line when the number of Monte-Carlo rollouts is approximately 350?

The red line represents the performance of the text-unaware latent-variable model, while the green line represents the performance of the text-aware full model. At approximately 350 Monte-Carlo rollouts, the green line (full model) is consistently above the red line (latent variable model). Therefore, the observed game score of the red line is lower than that of the green line at this point.
